name: Yugoslavia (Democratic Federal, 1943–1946)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, white and red with a red five-pointed star, without a border, in the centre.
history: The pan-Slavic tricolour of the Kingdom of Yugoslavia with a plain red star added by the Partisans, used by the Democratic Federal Yugoslavia proclaimed at Jajce in November 1943 and made official after the abolition of the monarchy in 1945. The constitution of 31 January 1946 added a yellow border to the star, producing the flag of the socialist federation.
